video_title: Melo Explains Why Brunson's Pay Cut Set a BAD PRECEDENT for KAT

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' contract negotiations and the Knicks' reported offer
quotes.excerpt: The reports are the Knicks have offered 200. And KAT is like, no.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: But if I'm KAT, ain't no way. Jalen Brunson just signed for 200 million, man. I'm not signing no damn 200. I ain't got to break the bank at 276, but meet me at 240, 250.

text_blocks.speaker: Kazeem Famuyide
text_blocks.text: But see, the problem was is that you saw what Jalen Brunson did.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: The reports are the Knicks have offered 200. And KAT is like, no.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: We ain't talking about that. The number ain't close enough to 276 or KAT would have signed already.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Why the Knicks were right to pause contract negotiations
quotes.excerpt: The more we go back and negotiate during the season, we are fucking ourselves up.
quotes.quote: The more we go back and negotiate during the season, we are fucking ourselves up. So it was smart to dead the conversations. Now, how you dead the conversations is a problem. Right? No, I can't find out on Twitter if that's what happened. I don't know that.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: The difference between Jalen Brunson's pay cut and Karl-Anthony Towns' situation
quotes.excerpt: That was a great thing he did for him and his situation and it panned out.
quotes.quote: That was a great thing he did for him and his situation and it panned out and the Knicks won. So that is the golden child of somebody doing that, taking less to go win. This ain't the same situation over here with KAT because now we also talking about if I give you a five-year deal KAT here in New York, but the next five years as an organization as a team, do we believe that we can get this production from KAT over the next four to five years?

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks' leadership stance on the second apron
quotes.excerpt: It's rolling in that man up top and saying ain't no fucking second apron over here.
quotes.quote: It's rolling in that man up top and saying ain't no fucking second apron over here. It's simple. And so then if that is the case though, then the numbers just are the numbers. It's not even negotiating. The numbers are not negotiable. This second apron makes it where the numbers are not negotiable. And if an owner really stands strong on that second apron, there's nothing a team can do. You're not going in that. You're not dealing with that second apron.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's pay cut setting a bad precedent for future contracts
quotes.excerpt: It sets a bad precedent. Not that he shouldn't do it, that's his situation.
quotes.quote: It sets a bad precedent. Not that he shouldn't do it, that's his situation. But he set the precedent where now that precedent is being asked to the next person. And it's two different situations. If you had to put a dollar amount on being in a New York Knicks jersey and in this market, what would it be?
